issues.inference: The supplied rule merges b into d; the primary reference inventory distinguishes /b/ and /d/. This must be corrected and tested before adoption.

issues.fact: No aar-Latn pre/post files exist in this pinned Epitran tree. Long vowels are represented, but consonant gemination/stress/grammatical phrase-final changes are not established by this table alone.
Native /ɖ ħ ʕ/ need an explicit matching carrier phoneme table. Actual same-carrier reference audio/embedding and selected-voice projection have not been prepared.

primary_comparison_sources.basis: NCSU research inventory referencing Bliese1981; b,d,retroflex/pharyngeal inventory and long vowels are separately listed.

primary_comparison_sources.author: R. J. Hayward
primary_comparison_sources.basis: Primary field research describes distinct stops and complex segmental/grammatical context; this simple map is not complete pronunciation acceptance.

interpretation: Potential reusable rules frontend only. It does not add an installed language or close any acoustic quality requirement.
